# jumpcloud_command_association (Resource)

Associates a JumpCloud command with a system or system group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_command_association" "example" {
  command_id  = jumpcloud_command.security_audit.id
  target_id   = "system-group-id"
  target_type = "system_group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command_id` (String) The ID of the command.
- `target_id` (String) The ID of the target system or system group.
- `target_type` (String) The type of target: system or system_group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the format command_id/target_type/target_id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_command_association.example <command-id>/<target-type>/<target-id>
```
